species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 73°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 4–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
East wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
